rationale: PINE 43 EXPANSION (E Pine Ave, Locust Grove→Hickory, ~1.4 mi N). Filed under the legacy 'Pine 43' name — invisible to brand-name searches. The single most material entitled threat in the ring.

Combined: ~526 latent/contested units in the south ag belt.

zoning_plain: General Retail & Service Commercial (City of Meridian)
rationale: 2600 E OVERLAND — THE 'SEASONS AT MERIDIAN II' SITE (0.1 mi W, touching parcel). The audit's headline correction: Morgan Stonehill's 351/345-unit Phase II (H-2022-0030, filed as 'Overland & Wells II') was DENIED 10/25/2022 (findings 11/9/2022 — employment-land loss, failing Overland/Eagle intersections, MF over-concentration next to Phase 1). No CUP ever issued, no re-application through Aug 2026. Owner WinCo Foods lot-split the 18 ac in Feb 2025 and markets it via Colliers as big-box/pad retail ground leases. Dead as MF (~5% de-novo revival, earliest ~2030); the denial precedent protects the subject's node. Residual outcome here is retail (amenity-positive, traffic-negative).

zoning_plain: General Retail & Service Commercial (City of Meridian)
rationale: KLEINER TRUST FIELD (3000 E Fairview + N Eagle Rd parcels, 71.8 ac C-G, 2.0-2.3 mi N). Held by the Julius Kleiner family trust for decades: no applications, not listed; a 2018 CenterCal concept was disavowed, and CenterCal dropped 549 apartments at the adjacent Village expansion for lack of demand. The ring's biggest long-term optionality, with zero current motion — watch for a listing or pre-app, which would be a regime change.
